scope: Exact source/receipt archive and native boards. Generic frozen reporter wording H1/aggregation is inherited; this experiment compares neural nuisance/conditional H1 with global masks, not phase aggregation or historical-mask equivalence. All34 figures actually viewed, with two supplemental building failure coordinates retained. The primary comparison is conditional neural nuisance versus conditional analytic H1 under the same global CFA mask. No exact-GT claim or pixelwise score for real references.
quality_decision: Less added quiet/building error but clearest-prior weak-detail recovery lost; no general weak-detail improvement or model promotion. V120 remains photographic recommendation.
